title: AirAnchor: Bridging Local and Global Spatial Information for Zero-Shot Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08442v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation requires drones to follow natural-language instructions and navigate through complex urban environments. Accurate navigation relies on both local and global spatial information, which support immediate action grounding and long-horizon path planning, respectively. However, existing zero-shot methods typically operate at a single spatial scale, relying either on local representations constructed online from current observations or on global memories built offline from historical experience. To address this limitation, we propose AirAnchor, a new paradigm that bridges local and global spatial information through spatial anchors and integrates both into a shared navigation framework, enabling comprehensive spatial grounding for decision-making. translated_title: AirAnchor：桥接局部与全局空间信息以实现零样本航空视觉与语言导航
translated_abstract: 航空视觉与语言导航（Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation）要求无人机遵循自然语言指令并在复杂的城市环境中进行导航。准确的导航同时依赖于局部和全局空间信息，前者支持即时动作的落地执行，后者支持长时程路径规划。然而，现有的零样本方法通常只在单一空间尺度上运行，要么依赖于从当前观测在线构建的局部表征，要么依赖于从历史经验离线构建的全局记忆。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了AirAnchor，这是一种新范式，通过空间锚点桥接局部与全局空间信息，并将两者整合到统一的导航框架中，为决策提供全面的空间定位。AirAnchor包含三个核心组件：(1) 查询驱动的空间锚点定位，用于从视觉观测中识别与决策相关的锚点……
tldr: 提出AirAnchor新范式，通过空间锚点桥接局部与全局空间信息，并将两者整合到统一的导航框架中，为零样本航空视觉语言导航提供全面的空间定位以支持决策。
en_tdlr: AirAnchor proposes a new paradigm that bridges local and global spatial information through spatial anchors, integrating both into a shared navigation framework to enable comprehensive spatial grounding for zero-shot aerial vision-and-language navigation.
